headline: Garment workers blockade Mohakhali-Tejgaon road over unpaid wages
summary: Workers from NASSA Group blocked a major Dhaka road, causing significant traffic chaos as they demanded their outstanding salaries.
details: Garment workers from the NASSA Group blocked the Mohakhali-Tejgaon road in Dhaka to protest unpaid wages. The blockade caused severe traffic congestion in the area, bringing vehicle movement to a standstill.
The protesters, many of whom are women, sat on the road under umbrellas to shield themselves from the heat and rain, demanding that the factory management pay their outstanding salaries.
The protest was triggered by the failure of the factory owners to clear the wage arrears, leading the workers to take to the streets in a desperate bid to receive their earnings.
Traffic police and local authorities attempted to manage the situation, but the blockade continued for several hours, affecting thousands of commuters in the capital city.

headline_marked: Criminal Raihan prime suspect in [[Jubo Dal leader's murder]] in Raozan
headline: Criminal Raihan prime suspect in Jubo Dal leader's murder in Raozan
summary: A murder case has been filed naming a notorious criminal as the prime suspect in the killing of Jubo Dal leader Masudul Haque Chowdhury.
details: The family of Jubo Dal leader Masudul Haque Chowdhury has filed a murder case in Chattogram, naming a notorious criminal named Raihan as the prime suspect.
Masudul, 45, the senior joint convenor of the Upazila's Jubo Dal unit, was killed in Chaumuhani Bazar of Pahartali Union in Raozan on Saturday afternoon.
Masudul's elder brother, former union council chairman Peyarul Islam, lodged the case with Raozan Police Station late Monday night.
Raihan, the prime suspect, is already accused in several cases, including a double murder in Chattogram, according to Raozan Police chief (OC) Saiful Islam.
The case has been registered naming 10 other people and seven or eight unidentified suspects, bringing the total number of accused to 19.
Police have already arrested one suspect named Zakir, who is also named in the case.
Masudul was buried at his village home on Sunday following a postmortem examination.
Raozan police are currently working to arrest the remaining suspects involved in the killing.
